Python / Cloud Engineer
 



 Overview
 



 We are looking for a highly skilled Python Engineer to join our growing technology organization. This individual will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling the firm’s backend systems and cloud infrastructure supporting both internal platforms and customer\-facing applications. The ideal candidate has deep experience building secure, distributed systems within AWS environments and thrives in high\-performance engineering teams.
 



 Responsibilities
 


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs
* Contribute to architectural direction and help evolve the firm’s backend infrastructure for scalability, reliability, and long\-term maintainability
* Build and support platform services, authentication/account systems, and core application infrastructure
* Develop and maintain cloud\-native data infrastructure leveraging AWS services such as S3, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and Redshift
* Architect and implement serverless and event\-driven systems using technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, and related AWS services
* Improve system resiliency, observability, fault tolerance, and production reliability across core platforms
* Automate operational processes and improve engineering workflows across the organization
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, and distributed systems challenges
* Stay current with modern Python development practices, AWS technologies, and cloud engineering best practices



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 7\+ years of experience in backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering
* Strong Python expertise, including modern Python features and asynchronous programming concepts
* Deep experience building and operating systems within AWS cloud environments
* Experience working with large\-scale datasets and data processing frameworks such as Pandas, PyArrow, Polars, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of event\-driven architectures, distributed systems, messaging frameworks, and orchestration patterns
* Experience working in Linux\-based environments with strong scripting and systems knowledge
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation and modern CI/CD pipelines
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams



 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience building highly available, low\-latency distributed systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native observability and monitoring tools
* Background working in financial services, trading, or data\-intensive environments is a plus
